name: Variable Library support for Eventstream
description: Eventstream now integrates with the Fabric Variable Library, so configurations can reference workspace variables. This makes Eventstream definitions portable across development, test, and production workspaces.With this capability, you can:- Reference workspace variables for connection identifiers and item references.- Reuse a single Eventstream definition across environments by swapping variable values.- Manage configuration centrally in the variable library instead of editing each item.
